main_text.p: potius inferendam : cum tamen legibus tantum permissum sit illatam injuriam pro-l.1. Cod. Vnde vi.pulsare. Respondeo enim, satis videri vim illatam ; quando terrorem alicui incutimus, quando ea adsunt , ad quae quam proximè , tanquam ad causam mors aggressi subsequeretur.
main_text.head: CAP. XXIV.

head.i: Utrum ad defensionem pudicitiae stuprare volentem liceat necare?

main_text.p: CVM honor praecipuus sit hominis Thesaurus , in tantum ut ejus amittendi periculum vitae periculo aequiparetur ; puellisque ac pueris metus stupri major esse soleat, metu mortis. page.notes: The marginal note at the left is printed in two short lines, "l.1. Cod." and "Vnde vi.", and is copied as one note. The reading "Vnde" is uncertain in the scan. The catchword "mor-" is printed with a hyphen and is copied as printed. The large initial "C" of "CVM" is joined to its word as the instructions require.
